description: Shape of the glucose bucket the app uploads (PUT /readings/buckets). A bucket is one 15-minute interval aligned to UTC, with its readings counted per whole mg/dL: 'mgDl' lists the distinct values (ascending, clamped to minMgDl..maxMgDl) and 'counts' how many readings had each. Every real time zone has a UTC offset that is a multiple of 15 minutes, so a bucket never straddles a local midnight and the server can build a day in any zone exactly. Shared by the app, the backend and their tests.
